overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission met to consider and approve multiple special one-day licenses, a change of hours, a change of manager application, and seasonal 2026 Farmers Market permits.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from March 18, 2026.

items.title: Ho Lin Palace 2 Change of Hours Application
items.summary: Approved a change of hours application for Chen Hong LLC, doing business as Ho Lin Palace 2, adjusting Sunday opening hours to noon to align with its common victualler license.

items.title: Friends of the Medford Public Library One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for the Friends of the Medford Public Library trivia fundraiser scheduled for May 2, 2026.

items.title: Medford Historical Society One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for the Medford Historical Society annual meeting and trivia night on May 7, 2026.

items.title: Event Them One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day liquor licenses for Event Them for an art reception on April 29, 2026, and a fashion show on May 16, 2026.

items.title: La Fiesta de la Republic Italiana One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day wine and malt licenses for La Fiesta de la Republic Italiana for events on May 30 and May 31, 2026.

items.title: Cappy's Liquors Change of Manager Application
items.summary: Approved a change of manager application appointing James Williams as manager for Medford Cappies Inc., contingent upon receiving required corporate vote signatures.

items.title: Blisspoint Meadery Farmers Market Permit
items.summary: Approved a 2026 Farmers Market permit for Blisspoint Meadery.

items.title: Broken Creek Vineyard Farmers Market Permit
items.summary: Approved a 2026 Farmers Market permit for Broken Creek Vineyard, contingent on submitting an updated farmer-winery license certificate.

items.title: Stormalong Cider Farmers Market Permit
items.summary: Approved a 2026 Farmers Market permit for Stormalong Cider.
